summary: Dying Light entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Dying Light
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC Definitive Edition / current PC build with DLC documented

primary.why: Dying Light's PC route has the strongest capture/settings path and the Definitive Edition is the cleanest content-complete route for the base game plus major DLC. Console and Switch editions are valid access routes, but PC is the best archive target if DLC and co-op/service state are documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC Definitive Edition or an owned PC build with equivalent DLC. Record build/date, edition, DLC installed, graphics settings, controller or mouse/keyboard, co-op state, Be the Zombie state, and whether The Following was included.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the Switch conversion.
secondary.why: PC has stronger fidelity/capture control, while Switch is a different access route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original release family, with PC preferred for capture/settings.
Expanded route including The Following and major content updates.
all_releases.reason: primary: include when documenting content-complete Dying Light.

all_releases.platform: Definitive Edition on PC and consoles
all_releases.fidelity: Most complete bundled edition of the first Dying Light.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Edition/DLC ownership, online co-op state, and whether The Following is included define content completeness.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record edition, DLC installed, co-op/service state, and whether The Following is treated as part of the run.

entries.title: Dying Light 2 Stay Human
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC Reloaded Edition/build with DLC and patch state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with documented DLC/settings

primary.why: Dying Light 2 is an update-heavy open-world sequel, and the current PC route has the strongest capture/settings path. Edition state, Bloody Ties and other DLC, co-op state, and patch version need to be logged because the game changed substantially after launch.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC build. Record storefront/build, edition, DLC installed, graphics/settings, controller or mouse/keyboard, co-op state, choices/ending route, New Game+/Legend state, and whether console versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting platform performance or controller route.
secondary.why: PC is the strongest capture/settings route.
